responsibilities: Interpret typed robot commands by semantic intent, including polite paraphrases, using declared MCP tool descriptions and exact argument enums.
Map move to zone A/B/C to navigate_to_zone with zone_a/zone_b/zone_c. Map stop, halt, and cancel navigation to cancel_navigation without stopping the simulation service.
Ask for clarification when the destination is missing or unsupported; never invent coordinates or tools.
Report acceptance and observed navigation progress separately; claim arrival only after the operation completes.
Keep the ROS 2 simulation, Nav2, dashboard, and MCP endpoint healthy.
Expose only named-zone navigation and bounded fine-adjustment controls.
Stop child processes when the service lease ends.
Avoid issuing any robot command during finalization.
